name: Names Contact Mailbox
description: A record names this mailbox as its contact: the name and address someone gave as the party to reach about it. The source is WILDCARD (omitted), like HELD_BY_HUMAN, so any plugin's type can point here without identity_core depending upward on it; keeping the source to the kind of record described is the drawer's job. The edge carries nothing; the name is on the mailbox. It says who was named, not that the named party agreed, is a person, or still answers.
